contacts.title: Let's talk about your campaign
contacts.text: We'll help you choose stores and an advertising format.

start.title: Your next impression, at the right shelf
start.text: Choose your locations and set up a campaign in your account.

pricing.title: Choose how your brand meets the shopper
pricing.text: General rotation, shelf priority or video with sound. Find the format for your campaign.
pricing.contractTitle: Your price is fixed in the contract
pricing.contractText: Prices shown are minimum campaign budgets. The agreed price applies throughout the contract term. Terms for the next period are agreed using current rates, subject to your contract.

budget.a: No. The cards show the minimum campaign budget. Your contract sets the placement period and final price.

zones.q: How do zones differ from general rotation?
zones.a: General rotation covers carts in your selected stores. A plan with zones adds priority at selected shelves when a shopper approaches them.

renewal.a: The price agreed for your current contract term remains fixed. After that term, new placements or renewals are agreed at current rates, unless your contract states otherwise.

stores.title: Closer to your shoppers
stores.text: Find a store, see its screen count and available zones. Add your chosen location to your next campaign.
stores.noZones: The zone list is not available yet.
stores.errorText: Try again or contact us to find suitable locations.
stores.emptyText: The location list is currently unavailable. Message us to discuss available stores and placement options.
stores.guestEmptyText: The location list is currently unavailable without signing in. Sign in or message us to find suitable stores.
stores.trySearch: Try another address or name, or select all cities.

how.eyebrow: From your video to the shopper
how.title: Advertising at the moment of choice
how.text: A cart screen introduces your brand right in the store. Zone placements help show your video at the right shelf.
how.sceneCaption: The right product. The right place. Your video.

approach.title: A shopper reaches the shelf
approach.text: The cart enters your selected area of the store.

watch.title: Your video plays on screen
watch.text: A short video presents the product right beside it.

count.title: The system records a play
count.text: Completed plays are added to your campaign data.

how.stepsText: Select a step to see an example setup.
how.zonesNote: Zone selection is available with Standard + Zones and Premium.

video.title: Upload your video
video.text: A 7-second video, a title and a description of your ad.

tariff.title: Choose your plan
tariff.text: Select the advertising format and minimum budget.

stores.title: Pick your stores
stores.text: Find suitable locations by city and address.

zones.title: Choose your shelves
zones.text: Add the product zones where you want your ad to play.

budget.title: Set your budget
budget.text: Check the settings and submit your campaign for review.

review.title: We review your ad
review.text: Review takes up to one business day. If changes are needed, you'll see the reason in your account.

launch.title: Your campaign launches
launch.text: After approval, payment and materials are ready, according to the dates in your contract.

results.title: Track the results
results.text: Follow impressions and budget spending in your account.

video.a: A horizontal MP4 or MOV video, 7 seconds long, with a 16:9 aspect ratio, at least 1280 × 720 resolution and a file size up to 50 MB.

timing.q: When will my ad start playing?
timing.a: Your video first goes through review, usually within one business day. The start date depends on agreed dates, payment and the readiness of your materials.

impression.a: A completed playback of your video on a cart screen. This measures plays, not the number of unique shoppers.
